MATCH DAY

In just a couple of hours, we’re back on home soil as we welcome @SandbachFC_1st 

🕒 15:00 PM KO
🆚 @SandbachFC_1st 
📍  Ideal Building Systems Stadium, SK8 2ET
🎟️ Adults £6 | Concessions £3

#Wearenomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores https://t.co/myYHhYLFCF
Sandbach are up for this game today and line up as follows https://t.co/PgWfOzyqs4

𝑻𝑬𝑨𝑴 𝑵𝑬𝑾𝑺 🗞️

Your Nomads XI is locked in for today’s clash! 🔒

Here’s how we line up as we look to get three points on the board this afternoon ⤵️

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores https://t.co/kbp9PrxXPu

1’ | KICK-OFF

LETS GO NOMADS!

@CheadleNomads 0-0 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores

1’ | CHANCE

Ewelike bursts down the left flank before delivering a dangerous ball into the box. Lewis rises highest to meet it, but his header is comfortably gathered by the Sandbach goalkeeper.

@CheadleNomads 0-0 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores
5’ gone and both sides have had a decent chance but not capitalised.
Tatters starting today marked his 200th appearance for Sandbach. Outstanding effort and commitment to the club 🙌🏻
Very soft card that however Tats goes in the book on the 9th minute https://t.co/1T1O0tlVMP
1-0 on 18’ as a ball high and deep over the box is shinned in with a looping goal.  Need to pick up the free players.

19’ | GOAL

WOODS! WHAT A FINISH!

Woods picks up the ball on the edge of the box, flicks it over his man with his left foot before unleashing a fierce strike with his right to beat the Sandbach No. 1!

@CheadleNomads 1-0 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores
26’ gone and it’s 1-1 great goal from Foley as he turns twice and shots with accuracy from the angle to make the net bulge. https://t.co/AAQOGtiXyt

26’ | GOAL

Sandbach find the equaliser. Their attacker twists and turns on the edge of the box before unleashing a powerful strike into the right side netting.

@CheadleNomads 1-1 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScore

Good goal from Nomads on 28’ to retake the lead a floating accurate shot narrowly off the top bin hits the post and goes in. Good strike. 

2-1

29’ | GOAL

An instant response from the Nomads! Colville picks up the ball just outside the box, takes aim and whips a stunning effort towards goal — it rattles both posts and finds the back of the net!

@CheadleNomads 2-1 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScore
Back underway with work to do for the Ramblers to get back into this game.

45’ | HALF-TIME

The Nomads head into the break with the lead!

Two absolute worldies from Dylan Woods and George Colville have put us in front after an entertaining first half.

@CheadleNomads 2-1 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScore https://t.co/Gb8bM0mMjy

45’ | KICK-OFF

And we are back underway

@CheadleNomads 2-1 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScore

51’ | SUBSTITUTE 

➡️ 17. D.Almeida
⬅️ 11. C.Ewelike

@CheadleNomads 2-1 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScore https://t.co/cdffPpPite

Sub
Pollard and Williams off
O’Connell and K Nolan on
2-2 and it is Top Scoring O’Connell once again with a close range diving header in the 63rd minute https://t.co/DnrtiyZqVK

63’ | GOAL 

Sandbach find the equaliser once again.

@CheadleNomads 2-2 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores
The two Sandbach subs have changed the dynamic and shape with the Ramblers now gaining some traction in midfield that was missing in the first half.

67’ | SUBSTITUTE

➡️ 12. E.Thompson
⬅️ 9. D.Lewis

@CheadleNomads 2-2 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores https://t.co/h0N6XsJ2Wl

Sub
Barry off
Fowles on
Good impact from Fowles who finds himself involved in the game with great movement

76’ | SUBSTITUTE

➡️ 14. K.Depeiaza
⬅️ 2. C.Graham

@CheadleNomads 2-2 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores https://t.co/CcJM2cxO4g

2-3 as Foley grabs a brace after Hatton works hard to win the ball and places a killer ball through for Foley to slot in beyond the closing keeper. 

77’ gone https://t.co/VVr1enVhGD

77’ | GOAL

Sandbach turn it around and take the lead for the first time this afternoon.

@CheadleNomads 2-3 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores

84’ | SUBSTITUTE 

➡️ 15. L.Knight
⬅️ 7. D.Woods

@CheadleNomads 2-3 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores https://t.co/QCdNa7W35H
Chance for Fowles but AJ makes it tough for him and Fowles can’t quite get the shot around the keeper.
The Subs from Sandbach have completely changed this game

A free kick delivered by AJ for nomads floats in finds a team mate who heads across goal and it’s nodded in at close range 

3-3 

Seconds to play
FT 3-3 feels like a loss conceding so late but credit nomads for not giving up

90+2’ | GOAL 

WE’RE LEVEL!

AJ launches the ball forward, Almeida fires it across the box, and Higgy is there to smash home the equaliser!

@CheadleNomads 3-3 @SandbachFC_1st 

#WeAreNomads | @nwcfl | @NWCFLScores
